note: Every PERSUADE 2.0 essay of the independent (no source text) task that carries competition_set="train", that is, was released in the Kaggle Feedback Prize competition launched in December 2021. That release is the evidence that these essays were written before ChatGPT. Read from the official annotation-level file persuade_corpus_2.0_train.csv (616,894,963 bytes, linked from the README of github.com/scrosseye/persuade_corpus_2.0), which the measured mirror does not carry. An essay is matched on its text rather than its id, because a spreadsheet damaged some ids in the mirror.
key: first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of full_text, as the official file stores it
